New OTT Releases Include 'Dhamaal 4' and 'Mayday' This Weekend

Several new films and series are set to premiere on various Over-The-Top (OTT) platforms this weekend, starting September 4, 2026. The slate includes the anticipated fourth installment of the 'Dhamaal' franchise, alongside titles like 'Mayday' and 'Gandhari'. These releases will be available across platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, JioHotstar, and SonyLIV, offering a variety of genres and languages for viewers.
